_about: Stage 6 events and story layer: how often events come, deadlines, player mood, the press and how well the staff answer for you. Read by src/sim/career/story.ts. Events themselves live in src/data/events.

pace._about: Chance of 0, 1, 2 or 3 new events in a week, by story pace. 'window' is used instead in transfer-window weeks (pre-season and the mid-season window) and is scaled toward calm/busy by windowShift.

defaults._about: Event fields left out of the data. deadline is in weeks: the staff answer when the owner has not after that many weeks. cooldown: weeks before the same event can come again.

money._about: Event amounts are written for a mid-sized club and scaled by market size: scale = base + perMarket x marketSize, rounded to round.

mood._about: Player mood 0-1. Each week it moves drift of the way toward a target: neutral, plus playTime x (share of matches played - what his squad role expects), plus perResult for each of the team's last five results (W +, L -). Pre-season it drifts toward neutral. unhappyBelow marks a player as unhappy for events. matchForm: the eleven's average mood shifts every attribute by up to this share on match day ((mood - neutral) / (1 - neutral) of it).

press._about: Press standing 0-1 drifts back toward neutral each week. fanLift moves fan mood each week by (press - neutral) x fanLift.

goodwill._about: Sponsor goodwill 0-1 scales the next shirt sponsor offers by 1 + (goodwill - neutral) x offerSwing, and drifts back toward neutral each week.

staff._about: Who answers for the owner, by visitor role, and how well. q is the staff member's rating / 99. Good effects (mood, fans, press, goodwill going up) are scaled by goodBase + goodGain x q; bad ones by badBase - badGain x q. Money is never scaled.

promises._about: What happens when a promise comes due. Kept and broken effects apply to the player the promise was made to (mood), the squad, and the press.

keep._about: Answered events are dropped after this many weeks (their inbox message stays). Decisions are kept for this season and the last.
